verdict.rationale: Fireflies' homepage says it delivers "customized summaries" after every meeting, which hints that note output can be shaped. Nothing in the pack shows templates or saved prompts tied to meeting types like discovery calls, 1:1s or standups. AskFred offers natural-language Q&A over transcripts, not reusable note formats. Missing for 10: documented custom note templates, saved prompts, per-meeting-type template assignment or auto-selection, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
